answer: A voyage through an agent economy should begin with one ember of real identity, not a forest fire of copies. Each person gets a single zero-knowledge personhood credential: an issuer verifies uniqueness once, then issues a proof that reveals nothing else, usable under a violet pseudonym unlinkable across services. The same person cannot mint a second valid credential, so a sybil farmer must recruit one real human per fake identity, paying that cost every time. Limit: it trusts issuers to check uniqueness honestly, and people without an issuer are locked out.
